mechanical.description: Cheap, fast tier: commit messages, tests, slop detection, compression.

standard.description: Mid tier: reviews, plans, design docs.

architectural.description: Top tier: design review, architecture, prompt evolution, and any task routing is unsure about.

dailyUsd.description: Spend cap per UTC day in US dollars. null disables the cap.

perTaskUsd.description: Spend cap for a single command in US dollars. null disables the cap.

onBreach.description: What happens when a cap is reached: degrade to the lower tier, or stop with a message.

repoAliases.description: Short names for GitHub repositories, used by `maina ticket`.

telemetry.description: 1.x setup telemetry opt-out (false opts out). Superseded by policy.telemetry.
